versions.content: RTEEvent pairing constraint in System context RTEEvent s defined in the context of a System that are mapped by RteEventInSystemToOsT- askProxyMapping s to the same OsTaskProxy shall be mapped together to the same OsTask. Optionally an order of the RTEEvent s in the OsTaskProxy can be defined with the offset attribute.
